en: The drop algorithm: draw by weight until a minimum total value is reached

maxDraws: most draws in one roll (a safety cap); baseWeight: a drop without its own value is worth baseWeight / its weight; empty.share / empty.value: the empty slot of every pool, its share of the draws and what it counts towards the minimum; tiers.common / uncommon: share of the pool weight from which a drop shows as common / uncommon (else rare).
掉落：「最多抽取次数」是一次掉落最多抽几次（防止死循环）；「基准权重」：没写价值的掉落物价值 = 基准权重 ÷ 自身权重；「空手」格的「占比」（占抽取次数的比例）和「数值」（计入最低总价值的价值）；「档位」：权重占比达到「常见」算"一般"、达到「少见」算"偶见"，否则"罕见"。
empty.share 是小于 1 的比例

en: Weight of drops by pool (or group of pools, e.g. "realms" for every realm and task) and drop id, e.g. { "realms": { "scrap-metal": 0 } } (0 = never). A pool's own entry wins over its group's. Partial: others keep theirs.
按奖励池（或一组池，例如"所有秘境"= 所有秘境的所有任务）和掉落项修改权重，0 = 不再掉落。单个池的设置优先于它所在组的；没写的保持原样。
